description: What Maps Agent has published, newest first. Without a form: how many pages each form has. With a form: its pages with title, summary, topic, date and URL, optionally narrowed by a topic word (an answer cluster such as 'reviews', a trade such as 'dentists', a guide kind such as 'template').

form.description: answer = one question answered first; guide = long reads, troubleshooting and copyable templates; research = our own measurements and statistics with method; glossary = terms; blog = articles; industry = what changes trade by trade; comparison = Maps Agent against other options; changelog = dated Google Business Profile changes.

offset.description: How many to skip, for paging (default 0).

topic.description: A word to narrow by topic or title, e.g. 'reviews', 'suspension', 'dentists'.

name: list_articles

forms.description: Without a form: how many pages each form has.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences: the page's description or opening.

topic.description: Grouping inside the form: answer cluster, guide kind, trade, blog vertical.

updated.description: The page's own last-updated day, YYYY-MM-DD.

url.description: The page on maps-agent.com — cite it.

total.description: Pages in the form (after the topic filter).

title: List published pages
